<!--
  Doctype: product — what a thing is, and the decision stack that shaped
  it. Copy to docs/<name>.md and fill in. Delete every comment, including
  this one; the document must read as if written directly.

  A spec is normative: when it and the artifact disagree, one of them is
  wrong — fix whichever lost, in the same change. A spec sentence is a
  predicate on system properties, a generating rule on system structure,
  or a decision record with reasons — never a mirror of what the artifact
  already says.

  required-fields: Doctype, Status, Scope, Last verified
  required-sections: Purpose, Non-goals and deferred work

  rubric:
  - [ ] Purpose states what the user gets before any mechanism.
  - [ ] Every decision heading carries the decision; its body carries the
        losing alternative and why it lost.
  - [ ] No sentence mirrors the artifact; values carry a reason and date,
        or name the constant that owns them.
  - [ ] The deferred ledger carries a reason and date per row.
-->
